name: Tally Comp
positioning: Tally Comp sells small businesses a fast, cheap workers' comp policy; Keelstone helps mid-market employers lower what they pay at every renewal, whoever their carrier is. When the prospect has more than 100 employees or a broker they trust, we win.

scorecard.note: Tally's tools only come with a Tally policy.

scorecard.capability: Leading indicators, not just loss runs
scorecard.note: Tally prices from payroll and class codes.
Tally sells direct and around brokers.
Their new dashboard covers premium and claims.

whyWeWin.point: Keep your carrier and your broker
Change the risk, not just the price
whyWeWin.proof: Leading indicators lower claim frequency, which lowers the mod.

whereTheyWin: Speed: quote and bind in minutes

objections.theySay: Tally will cut your premium 20% today.
objections.youSay: A lower price on the same risk lasts until the first big claim. Ask what happens to the rate at renewal.

objections.theySay: Tally includes a safety dashboard for free.
objections.youSay: It shows claims after they happen. Ask whether it can see a hazard before someone gets hurt.

landmines: Will you have to change carriers to use their tools?
How does your broker feel about a direct-to-employer policy?
What did your rate do at the second renewal?
messaging: Now with cost-of-risk insights for every policyholder

products.name: Tally Insights
products.description: Cost-of-risk dashboard for policyholders, launched October 2026

positive.detail: Quote to bind in one sitting.

fieldIntel.author: Priya S. (AE, Mid-Market)
fieldIntel.text: Tally pitched Tally Insights as 'Keelstone for free' to a 140-employee landscaper. Broker pushed back because Tally would replace the existing carrier.
